evals.prompt: pull the latest noam branch experiments and give me a full category breakdown — what's been tried, what merged, what closed
evals.expected_output: A markdown report with: (1) full PR catalogue table, (2) category breakdown table with merge rates, (3) merged-only summary, (4) closed-only failure patterns, (5) key narrative insights. Should use parallel subagents to analyze the PRs.

assertions.name: uses-9-category-taxonomy
assertions.description: Report uses the exact 9 categories: Loss function, LR / optimizer, Model architecture, Training efficiency, Regularization, Physics / normalization, Loss weighting, Feature engineering, Inference fix — at least 7 of 9 must appear

assertions.name: has-three-views
assertions.description: Report contains all three views: all PRs, merged-only, and closed-only sections

assertions.name: includes-merge-rates
assertions.description: Category breakdown table includes merge rate percentages

assertions.name: includes-pr-catalogue
assertions.description: Report includes a full PR catalogue table with individual PR rows (not just summaries)

assertions.name: identifies-cp-normalization-as-step-change
assertions.description: Report identifies PR #392 (Cp normalization) as a major/step-change improvement

assertions.name: has-narrative-insights
assertions.description: Report includes a narrative insights or key findings section with cross-cutting patterns

assertions.name: report-length
assertions.description: Report is at least 1000 words (comprehensive analysis of 150 PRs)

evals.prompt: i want to understand which experiment categories have had the best success rate in the senpai project. fetch the latest data and categorize all the PRs
evals.expected_output: A category breakdown showing merge rates per category, with the full PR catalogue and identification of which categories produced the most merged PRs.

assertions.name: uses-9-category-taxonomy
assertions.description: Report uses the exact 9 categories from the skill taxonomy — at least 7 must appear

assertions.name: has-merge-rate-comparison
assertions.description: Report ranks or compares categories by success/merge rate

assertions.name: includes-pr-catalogue
assertions.description: Report includes individual PR entries, not just aggregate counts

assertions.name: fetches-fresh-data
assertions.description: Report mentions fetching data or running a script (not just working from memory)

evals.prompt: bucket the experiment prs — show me all, then just the merged ones, then just the failed ones
evals.expected_output: Three views of the experiment PRs: all PRs categorized, merged-only view, closed-only failure patterns view. Categories from the 9-category taxonomy.

assertions.name: has-all-prs-section
assertions.description: Report has a section showing all PRs (or a full catalogue)

assertions.name: has-merged-only-section
assertions.description: Report has a distinct section for merged/successful PRs only

assertions.name: has-closed-only-section
assertions.description: Report has a distinct section for closed/failed PRs only

assertions.name: uses-consistent-categories
assertions.description: All three views use consistent category names from the 9-category taxonomy
